message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is a precise description of the brand mark:

1.  **Ornament Position:** There is **one** distinct dot/circle ornament. It is located at the **top-right** (or upper-right) extremity of the letter. Specifically, it forms the terminal point of a thin, sweeping curved line that extends from the top right arm of the "K".
2.  **Sweeping Curve Termination:** The sweeping curved stroke at the top-right **ends high up**. It does not extend down toward the bottom; instead, it curls inward and terminates at that single dot in the upper portion of the mark.
3.  **Bottom-Right Corner:** At the very bottom-right, there is the **flat base/foot** of the diagonal leg of the "K". It ends with a straight horizontal serif or baseline edge.
4.  **Bottom-Left:** At the bottom-left, there is the **flat base/foot** of the main vertical stem of the "K". Like the right side, it sits on a flat horizontal baseline with slight serif-like flaring.
